svg.text: BB Learn: the cute owlet, and a robot owl
on the PixelBoard · rough sketches · same cells and brightness levels as the site's 5×7 BRAINBACK
1 · The owlet: round 3's first drawing, and a refined version
soft, low contrast, small tall pupils
wider rounded eyes, pupils low and inward
On the board, as the BB LEARN lockup
ear tufts become antennae, chest feathers a chevron grille, wings side flaps, feet treads
binocular eyes on a neck, a boxy body, treads
the whole owl is one box; the meter fills as you learn
